questions.description: R044 Partners. Net earned and Net available are subtotals, not additional movements. Pending is reserved, not paid.
questions.name: How net available is calculated

stages.native:
WITH totals AS (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(interest_earned IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(interest_earned) END g,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(expenses IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(expenses) END x,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(net_earned IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(net_earned) END n,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(completed IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(completed) END c,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(pending IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(pending) END p,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(other_reserved IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(other_reserved) END o,CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN bool_and(available IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(available) END a FROM {{#318}} d WHERE true [[AND {{partner}}]])
 SELECT v.label AS "Entitlement bridge",v.amount AS "Amount ฿" FROM totals t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 (1,'Allocated interest',g),(2,'Less allocated expenses',-x),(3,'Net earned',n),(4,'Less completed payouts',-c),(5,'Less pending reservations',-p),(6,'Less other reservations',-o),(7,'Net available to settle',a)) v(ord,label,amount) WHERE v.ord<>6 OR o<>0 ORDER BY v.ord

visualization_settings.text:
## Partners
Current capital, earned profit and settlements. All amounts are baht; current balances stay current when activity dates change.

### Actual activity · selected dates
Net earnings are after allocated expenses. Payouts use transfer dates and may include profit earned earlier. Partial months show only selected dates.

### Pending settlements · current
All pending reservations are shown, including future or missing transfer dates. A blank table means there are no pending settlements; the activity period does not apply.

### Transaction detail · selected dates
Capital withdrawals and profit payouts are separate. The status filter affects the settlement ledger only. Cancelled entries remain visible as history.

Net available is an entitlement after reservations, not cash on hand. Current totals use all recorded balances; past activity is restated by corrections. [Cash Position](/dashboard/3?tab=14) shows liquidity. Complete settlements in OLAP.
